messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency breach in us-west-2 (gpu-shared-02). Streaming stalls observed; p95=420ms, p99=3.1s, error-rate stable. Affected route: /v1/stream/generate. Auto-page oncall. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streams/gpu-shared-02

alice (oncall): I'm on it. pulling up traces and tail logs now.

carla (infra): seeing IO wait and writeback spikes on host gpu-12 (shared pool). dmesg shows repeated cgroup throttle messages.

bob (runtime): could be KV-cache churn + disk writeback for checkpoints. streaming workers showing long tail waiting on epoll. checking per-tenant qps.

mara (ml): any recent model rollouts to that pool? I don't see new deploys in the last 6h against gpu-shared-02.

alice (oncall): confirmed: no model deploys. top consumer list by cgroups attached.

alice (oncall): ```
# top 5 tenants by GPU memory & IO
tenant-1128  | 48GB GPU / heavy small-token streaming
tenant-2210  | 36GB
tenant-0044  | 12GB
tenant-7001  | 8GB
tenant-1999  | 6GB
```

bob (runtime): tenant-1128 is doing many long-lived streaming sessions with small prefix churn — likely KV-cache eviction thrash. That can push IO and cause others to block on NVMe-backed swap or writeback.

carla (infra): host-level snapshot: ```
I/O util 98%
writeback spikes 450MB/s
cgroup.qos.io.throttle_count=5462
```

alice (oncall): customer impact check: running quick query. Looks like ~18k streaming requests in last 5m; 12 tenants had p99 > 2s. No 5xx spike but client-side timeouts reported.

eve (support): I've got two enterprise customers reporting timeouts: Acme Analytics and BetaApps. Opening support threads to notify SLAs may be affected.

frank (cust-succ): prepping templated message for impacted customers. will wait for mitigation step then update.

dave (prod): priority: reduce customer-visible p99 ASAP. Keep me posted on rollback/eviction plan.

bob (runtime): mitigation options: 1) evict top noisy tenant (tenant-1128) from shared pool -> immediate relief; 2) throttle tenant cgroups (limit BIO/writeback) -> softer; 3) migrate heavy sessions to dedicated pool if tenant has commit. eviction fastest.

alice (oncall): agree. initiating eviction plan: will cordon affected hosts and drain tenant-1128 tasks to prevent further writeback. Notifying deploy-bot to run drain.

deploy-bot: running drain command: `rb pool drain --pool gpu-shared-02 --tenant tenant-1128 --grace 30s`

alice (oncall): executing now.

carla (infra): starting host cordon sequence for gpu-12 and gpu-13. will force-stop long-running containers if they don't exit in 45s.

mara (ml): tenant-1128 uses a newer quantized model that keeps heavy KV state in memory; eviction will also clear large caches and probably reduce writeback. good tradeoff.

alice (oncall): eviction completed. logs: ```
2026-03-15T15:02:10Z evict: tenant-1128 tasks terminated (count=24)
2026-03-15T15:02:12Z pool:  gpu-shared-02 running tenants=43 -> 42
```

incident-bot: NOTE: automated rollback suppression active for tenant-1128 (avoid auto-redeploy into shared pool).

alice (oncall): metrics after eviction: p95=300ms, p99=640ms. streaming stalls reduced. still some hosts with elevated io but trending down.

bob (runtime): nice, big improvement. Recommend follow-ups: a) permanent QoS for writeback limits on shared pool; b) workload-based placement rule: flag tenants with >X streaming sessions for dedicated pool; c) add KV-cache eviction gating to prevent thrash.

carla (infra): putting temporary cgroup QoS tweak in place for gpu-shared-02 to cap writeback per tenant. Command: ```
echo 50M > /sys/fs/cgroup/tenant-*/blkio/writeback_limit
```

mara (ml): I'll add a model-detection rule to runtime to mark models that keep large KV and avoid colocating many of them on same host.

eve (support): customer comms: Acme notified: "we observed increased streaming latency from ~15:00-15:05 UTC, we've mitigated and are monitoring." Will update with root cause once finalized.

frank (cust-succ): scheduled follow-up call with Acme for 16:30 UTC. prepping impact notes.

alice (oncall): handing off to carla for remediation and follow-up monitoring. I'll remain available if it resurfaces.

carla (infra): taking lead. tasks: 1) verify no backfill of tenant-1128 into shared pool, 2) tune cgroup writeback caps, 3) schedule migration plan for heavy tenants, 4) document incident in postmortem.

dave (prod): assign owners for follow-ups: bob -> placement rules, mara -> model gating, carla -> infra caps & migration, eve/frank -> customer comms. expected initial postmortem draft in 24h.

alice (oncall): closing page. marking incident as mitigated (p99 back under SLO). If any of you see regressions ping here. :white_check_mark:
